name: Framework help (drafts)
description: Help mode entries for framework. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Session
entries.text: Opens Session.

entries.title: Brief ( characters)
entries.text: Shows “Brief ( characters)”.

entries.title: UI Review
entries.text: Shows “UI Review”.

entries.title: The build
entries.text: Shows “The build”.

entries.title: Console
entries.text: Shows “Console”.

entries.title: axHub
entries.text: Shows “axHub”.

entries.title: Replay the animation
entries.text: Replays the animation.

entries.title: Preset
entries.text: Where you set “Preset”. Change it and the app uses the new value.

entries.title: Reset open menus and width
entries.text: Resets open menus and width. Your own changes go.

entries.title: Pinned
entries.text: Turns “Pinned” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered.

entries.title: Shown
entries.text: Turns “Shown” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered.

entries.title: Accent
entries.text: Where you set “Accent”. Change it and the app uses the new value.

entries.title: Reset custom to default
entries.text: Throws away this app's edits to the settings interface and goes back to the shared default.

entries.title: Tabs on top
entries.text: Lays the settings interface out with its tabs in a row across the top.

entries.title: Tabs at the side
entries.text: Lays the settings interface out with its tabs stacked down the side.

entries.title: List
entries.text: Lays the settings interface out as one list, no tabs.

entries.title: Full
entries.text: Shows the full header (title and description) above the settings.

entries.title: Compact
entries.text: Shows a slim one-line header above the settings.

entries.title: None
entries.text: Hides the header above the settings.

entries.title: Search field
entries.text: Shows a search box that filters the settings as you type.

entries.title: Descriptions
entries.text: Shows each setting's short description under its name.

entries.title: Hidden ids (comma-separated: a tab, group or field key)
entries.text: Tabs, groups or setting keys to hide from this app's settings interface, separated by commas.

entries.title: Banner settings (look, behaviour, Apply to all)
entries.text: Opens the full banner settings: its look, its behaviour, and Apply to all banners.

entries.title: Find a setting
entries.text: Type part of a setting's name to show only the settings that match.

entries.title: More
entries.text: Opens a menu with the tabs that don't fit in the row.

entries.title: Widgets on the top bar
entries.text: Shows “Widgets on the top bar”.

entries.title: Size
entries.text: Where you set “Size”. Change it and the app uses the new value.

entries.title: Shows
entries.text: Where you set “Shows”. Change it and the app uses the new value.

entries.title: Max width
entries.text: Where you set “Max width”. Change it and the app uses the new value.

entries.title: Width in
entries.text: Where you set “Width in”. Change it and the app uses the new value.

entries.title: Region
entries.text: Where you set “Region”. Change it and the app uses the new value.

entries.title: Priority
entries.text: Where you set “Priority”. Change it and the app uses the new value.

entries.title: Hide when there's nothing to report
entries.text: Turns “Hide when there's nothing to report” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered.

entries.title: Move into the ⋯ menu when space runs out
entries.text: Turns “Move into the ⋯ menu when space runs out” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered.

entries.title: Back to default
entries.text: Shows “Back to default”.

entries.title: Reset to default
entries.text: Resets to default. Your own changes go.

entries.title: Drag them on the banner
entries.text: Shows “Drag them on the banner”.

entries.title: Banner settings
entries.text: Opens the banner settings.

entries.title: Back to skin
entries.text: Drops your change to this one part, so it follows the skin again.

entries.title: Choose
entries.text: Opens the skin picker. Tap a skin to see it on this app, then Apply to keep it.

entries.title: Use skin
entries.text: On, this app wears the skin you picked. Off, it goes back to its own look and keeps your picks. Other apps never change.

entries.title: Undo
entries.text: Brings back the look you had before Restore to default. It works once.

entries.title: Turn skin off
entries.text: Takes the skin off this app and goes back to its own look.

entries.title: Choose a skin
entries.text: Pick a skin for this app. A tap shows it on the real app without saving; Apply keeps it, Cancel puts the look back, Reset goes to the app's default look.

entries.title: Restore to default
entries.text: Asks before putting this app back to its default look. Skin and picks are cleared, and you can undo it once in Settings → Appearance.
